ra-tkua-sverige-juel-261583-vibe-1649-16.summary: News of the Danish court from Copenhagen, January 1649 to September 1651: who obtains what from #211 and who is reconciled with whom; sailors and every man discontented while the Marselis and Friedrich Möller hold assignments on the best revenues of the realm; the High Steward kept at home by a pretended weakness; #228 asking satisfaction for an arrest and #211 a declaration about an alleged murder plot; the account of the Norwegian fleet; #422 to be judged; how to win #370 away from #422. The 22 code numbers that name the actors are not identified.

register_p115.summary: 442 said some days ago to 212 that the former 412 of 351 277 [...] her away, and that 401 shall now bring her back here again; the 412 of 426 drove with three wagons between. The codes name the people; none is identified.
